verdict.rationale: Clerk documents Enterprise SSO over SAML and OIDC with IdPs such as Azure AD, Okta, and Google Workspace, with user data synchronized into Clerk. It also documents multi-tenant Organizations. However, nothing in the pack ties an SSO connection to an individual customer organization, and nothing mentions domain verification or just-in-time provisioning. Missing for 10: per-organization SSO connection assignment, verified/claimed domains, explicit JIT provisioning into the org, independent or hands-on corroboration.
